0022600190.text: The Nets (2-6, fifth in the Atlantic and 5.5 games back, 13th in the East) visit the Hawks (5-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East), with Brooklyn on a one-game winning streak and Atlanta on two. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 series the Nets lost 0-4, including a 141-107 loss in Brooklyn in their most recent meeting on April 3, 2026. Egor Demin is out for Brooklyn with a leg bruise, while Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture).
